summary: Re-tested iteration_4 HIGH-priority fixes. Both root-cause fixes confirmed working: (1) PATCH /api/reminders/{id} now correctly returns 403 for RECEPTION and PRO via require_roles(OWNER_DOCTOR, DOCTOR, PHARMACY, ADMIN); PHARMACY still allowed on PHARMACY-audience reminders. (2) DELETE /api/patients/{id} cascade ordering fixed — case_ids are collected BEFORE delete_many on cases, so clinical_notes/prescriptions/payments/pharmacy_dispense are hard-deleted and attachments are soft-deleted (is_deleted=true). Added 3 new tests in TestReminders + 1 new TestPatientDeleteOrphanCheck class verifying DB-level orphan cleanup. Full regression: 98/98 PASS (~67s).

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration_4 — RECEPTION/PRO still cannot CREATE reminders (require_roles excludes them). Spec wording was ambiguous; main agent's decision to keep clinicians+admin only is consistent. Re-confirm intent if reception ever needs to schedule call-back reminders.
Carry-over — followups_today array still returns full reminder docs including the private 'message' field; PRO viewers can read clinician-written messages. Consider field-stripping for PRO role.
Carry-over — naive token word-count surfaces noise words. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Trim or scope the 'message' field on PRO dashboard followups_today to avoid leaking clinical notes.
(Optional) Decide whether RECEPTION should be allowed to POST /api/reminders for front-desk callbacks.
(Optional) Improve top_complaints with a richer stopword list or server-side aggregation when cases scale.

RECEPTION and PRO are correctly rejected with 403. Inner DOCTOR own-check (line 79) and PHARMACY audience-check (line 81) preserved.

VERIFIED FIX: routers/patients.py:98-109 — case_ids are collected BEFORE delete_many on cases. Cascade through clinical_notes/prescriptions/pharmacy_dispense/payments now executes correctly. attachments soft-delete via update_many also works. Audit log at end.

Carry-over (not blockers): send_whatsapp/send_sms remain sync inside async; attachment upload reads full body before 10MB check; admin_analytics fetches up to 5000 cases; AI prompt body not sanitised for injection. Twilio + WhatsApp providers intentionally unconfigured.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression now 98/98 across 4 files (test_sparsa_backend 33 + test_sparsa_round2 20 + test_sparsa_recap 18 + test_sparsa_round4 30). Total run ~67s. Direct-DB validation via pymongo is now in place for the patient-delete cascade. Twilio/WhatsApp remain intentionally unconfigured (POST /reminders/{id}/send_now returns provider-not-configured 200/4xx as expected). AI key still live. No new bugs found.
rca of the issue: Both iteration_4 RCAs verified resolved. (1) routers/reminders.py:72 dependency updated from get_current_user to require_roles(OWNER_DOCTOR, DOCTOR, PHARMACY, ADMIN). Reception/PRO now hit the role gate and receive 403 before any handler code runs. (2) routers/patients.py:99-100 swapped to async list comprehension on db.cases.find(...) BEFORE db.cases.delete_many(...), so case_ids is populated and the subsequent delete_many on clinical_notes/prescriptions/pharmacy_dispense/payments and update_many on attachments operate on the correct id set. Reproduction (positive): create patient -> case -> notes+rx+payment+attachment+pharmacy_dispense -> DELETE patient as admin -> pymongo count_documents for each collateral collection returns 0 (or is_deleted=true for attachments).
